{"metadata":{"description":"A model-native meta-agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness that uses the underlying model’s reasoning and planning capabilities to synthesize task-specific workflows at runtime and coordinate tools and subagents.","id":"gh:1333331301","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-meta-orchestrator","slug":"jiruidai/dsh-meta-orchestrator","topics":["agentic-workflow","autonomous-agents","cordis","dsh","dsh-plugin","dynamic-workflow","meta-agent","workflow-orchestration"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A model-native meta-agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness that uses the underlying model’s reasoning and"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" planning capabilities to synthesize task-specific workflows at runtime and coordinate tools and sub"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ng capabilities to synthesize task-specific workflows at runtime and coordinate tools and subagents."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that teaches the agent to **synthesize a task-specific workflow at runtime"},{"id":"p2s2","text":"** — instead of hard-coding pipelines or fixed agent topologies. For anyone running multi-step work "},{"id":"p2s3","text":"in DSH who wants the plan the agent follows to be explicit, versioned, and durable rather than impli"},{"id":"p2s4","text":"SH who wants the plan the agent follows to be explicit, versioned, and durable rather than implicit."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"## 🧭 How it works"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Normally an agent just starts working on your request. With this plugin, it **plans first, then work"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s the plan** — and the workflow is dynamic: written by the model itself, per request:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"1. **Analyze** — the agent reads the request; if it is genuinely ambiguous, it asks before doing any"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"thing.
2. **Pick a pattern** — it chooses one of five proven ways to organize the work: ⛓️ steps in "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"order (`prompt-chaining`), ⚡ fan out independent parts (`parallel-workers`), 🔀 classify, then dispat"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ch (`router`), 🎯 delegate and review (`supervisor`), 🔁 draft → score → improve (`evaluation-loop`). "},{"id":"p5s5","text":"Each pattern's detailed playbook is loaded only when picked.
3. **Write the plan down** — it calls `"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"orchestrate` with the stages, the roles it will delegate, and verifiable success criteria. The plugi"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"n validates the structure and saves it durably. That is *all* the plugin ever does: it records plans"},{"id":"p5s8","text":", it never executes them.
4. **Do the work with DSH's own tools** — subagents, todos, workflow scrip"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"ts, plan mode. The plugin adds no runtime of its own.
5. **Adapt or close** — if reality diverges, `"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"adapt_workflow` revises the plan (every revision is versioned); when the work is done, `complete_wor"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"kflow` records how each success criterion turned out."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Simple requests skip all of this — the agent is explicitly told not to orchestrate for orchestration"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"equests skip all of this — the agent is explicitly told not to orchestrate for orchestration's sake."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"All of this behavior comes from one short instruction block the plugin adds to the agent's system pr"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ompt — no extra model calls, no background processes."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### What gets installed"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Added to your agent | What it is |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| An instruction block (~330 words) | Teaches the plan-first protocol above; sits in the system prom"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"pt of every session |
| Five pattern playbooks | Skills in the catalog; cost nothing until the model"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" loads one |
| `orchestrate` / `adapt_workflow` / `complete_workflow` | The three recording tools: s"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ave the plan, revise it, close it |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 🧩 Why it's built this way"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **The model is the planner** — no hard-coded pipeline and no fixed agent topology decides how your"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" task runs; the model picks and composes per request, and may deviate when the task demands it.
- **"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"Recording, not executing** — the plugin holds no runtime, no scheduler, no message bus. Execution st"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ays on the harness's battle-tested primitives, so there is nothing extra to break.
- **Plans survive"},{"id":"p13s5","text":" restarts** — every plan lives in DSH's storage domain as an append-only `create → adapt* → complete"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"` chain, fenced per session lifecycle. No custom session event types, so orchestrated sessions alway"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"s resume cleanly.
- **Built to track a fast-moving harness** — only stable public plugin surfaces ar"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"e used; nothing is pinned to harness internals."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"How it compares to other DSH orchestration plugins"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| | dsh-meta-orchestrator | workflow-capsule engines | agent-team plugins |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Who plans | The model, per request, at runtime | A generated script in a bundled sandbox runtime |"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" A fixed lead + specialists topology |
| Pattern choice | Selected and composed from five canonical "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"patterns | Baked into capsule scripts | One topology for every task |
| Execution | Harness-native p"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"rimitives only | Own QuickJS/WASM runtime + run store | Own mailbox/wake-up machinery |
| Re-plannin"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"g | `adapt_workflow` re-plans the pattern itself, versioned | Pause/resume/rerun of the same script "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"| Re-brief within the fixed topology |
| DSH coupling | Public plugin surface only | Pinned to a har"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"ness snapshot | Patches harness dependencies |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## ✅ Compatibility"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| DSH packages | peer range `@deepseek-ai/*@^0.1.0-rc.5` — **verified against `0.1.0-rc.6`**, the cu"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"rrent npm release |
| Mainline | `47f9438` (2026-08-13) |
| Last verified | **2026-08-14** — real np"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"m install, 46/46 tests, live `web` profile session |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| Profile |"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" needs the storage stack, shipped by the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` bundle (the standard `web` profi"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"le). The stock `headless` profile does **not** ship it — see Troubleshooting. |
| Platforms | Window"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"s 11 (dev), Ubuntu (CI) |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Only public plugin surfaces are used — `systemPrompt`, `skills`, `tools`, `storageDomain`, `agent/pr"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e-step` — so ordinary harness churn rarely bites. But the harness is pre-1.0, and a semver caret doe"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"s not span prerelease lines: `^0.1.0-rc.5` matches `0.1.0-rc.6`, not a future `0.1.1-rc.1`. When a n"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ew rc line lands, the peer range here needs a bump — open an issue if you get there first."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 📦 Install"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Requires a profile with the storage stack — the standard web profile (`dsh-web-app` bundle) ships it"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" (see Compatibility)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Upgrade"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## 🚧 Limitations"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Prompt discipline is the primary enforcement — a model may skip `orchestrate` entirely.
- Specs ar"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e per session lifecycle by design; a reused session id never inherits a stale workflow.
- No client "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"UI yet — workflow state is visible in conversation, tool results, and the storage domain."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## 📄 License & security"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"MIT."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**Reporting a vulnerability** — please don't open a public issue. Use GitHub's private vulnerability"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" reporting for this repo; see SECURITY.md. Surface-wise there is little to hold: the plugin executes"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" nothing, opens no sockets, and reads no credentials — the realistic concerns are the policy text it"},{"id":"p31s4","text":" injects and the task paraphrases it stores locally (see Permissions & data)."}],"truncated":true}
